land.text: Syunik, which 'proclaimed a separate kingdom from the Bagratids' in 987

predecessors.note: Syunik was a Bagratid vassal; Vasak Ishkhanik had taken a royal title in the late 9th century (Bagratid Armenia dossier). The page also puts the kingdom's start in the 970s.

land.text: Syunik, whose last stronghold was besieged in 1170 by the atabeks of the Eldiguzid (Ildigizian) house

successors.note: The page is machine-translated and garbled; it names an 'Eltkuzian (Ildigizian) or Parvanian dynasty of Atropatia' and the 'Yeltkuz atabek'.

capitals.name: Kapan
capitals.note: Infobox 'Capital: Kapan'; the Seljuks 'captured and destroyed Capan' in 1103 and the last stronghold in 1170 was Baghk; the page does not say the seat moved.

rulers.name: Smbat I
rulers.note: The list gives 970 (987) to 998; the text says eleven years.

rulers.name: Smbat II Ashotyan
rulers.note: The text gives 1040-1044 in one place.

correction.text: Syunik with Vayots Dzor: the kingdom 'included almost the entire Syunik region of present-day Armenia', with parts of Artsakh and Nakhichevan

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 987-988: Syunik and Vayots Dzor, before Gagik I 'took Jahuk and part of the Pot, including Vayots Dzor' (dated to his reign, 989-1020). The 'parts of Artsakh and Nakhichevan' are not delimited and are not drawn. The page is machine-translated and contradictory.

correction.text: Syunik without Vayots Dzor: 'about 1/3 of the historic Syunik (approximately 5,500 km2)' by the end of the 11th century

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 989-1170. The only area on the page is c. 5,500 km2 for the late 11th century; Syunik province resolves to 16 grid cells, about 4,050 km2 on the gazetteer (ratio 0.74 to the page), within a factor of two. The loss of Kapan in 1103 and the shrinking to the last stronghold by 1170 are not drawn.

region.text: Syunik, with Vayots Dzor before Gagik I's reign

ledger.note: 987: Syunik proclaims itself a kingdom separate from the Bagratids. Infobox 'Established: 987'; Syunik 'proclaimed a separate kingdom from the Bagratids' in 987, 'existed from 987-1170' (the page elsewhere says the Kingdom of Kapan was established in the 970s).

region.text: Vayots Dzor, Chahuk and part of Tsghukk

ledger.note: 989-1020: Gagik I of Armenia takes Vayots Dzor from Syunik. 'Gagik I took Jahuk and part of the Pot, including Vayots Dzor' from his vassal; the page dates it only to his reign (989-1020), and the Bagratid Armenia dossier's gain is entered at 989.

1170: the last stronghold of Syunik falls. 'In 1170, they besieged Baghdad [Baghk], the last stronghold of the kingdom' (the page's garbled name); the besiegers are the Eltkuzian (Ildigizian) atabeks of Atropatia.

wars.name: Gagik I against Syunik

zones.text: Vayots Dzor, Chahuk and part of Tsghukk

wars.outcome: Gagik I of Armenia took Vayots Dzor, Chahuk and part of Tsghukk from Syunik during his reign (989-1020).
wars.note: The page gives no year inside the reign.

wars.name: Seljuk invasions of Syunik
wars.outcome: 'In 1064, during the reign of Gregory I, Syunik was invaded'; 'In 1103, the Seljuks captured and destroyed Capan'; the kingdom survived as a shrunken principality to 1170.
wars.note: The page spells the invaders 'Seleucids'; no territorial transfer is dated, so no zone is drawn.

wars.name: Atabek siege of Baghk
wars.outcome: The Eldiguzid atabeks besieged the kingdom's last stronghold in 1170.
wars.note: The page's 'Baghdad' is read as Baghk; page garbled.

certainty.note: The page gives no borders; the province boundary of Syunik is drawn soft for the whole life.

sources.title: Kingdom of Syunik
sources.note: Infobox 987-1170, Kapan, extent (about 5,500 km2), kings' list, 1064/1103/1170. Machine-translated and internally contradictory (970s vs 987); the only page opened for the state (budget).

notes: Cliopatria has no Syunik row. The page is thin and garbled; every date outside the infobox (987, 1170) is the page's own but may be translation noise: 1064 and 1103 Seljuk blows are 'Seleucids' in the text; the Shaddadid conquest of Dvin in 1022 appears with no clear link to Syunik; 'Baghdad' is probably Baghk. The vassal relation to the Bagratids (885-987 and 988-1045) is carried by the bagratid-armenia dossier (vassal_start/vassal_end with counterpart kingdom-of-syunik); the page gives no overlordship dates. The 989 Vayots Dzor loss is a range (989-1020). Parts of Artsakh and Nakhichevan are not delimited. Successor: eldiguzids is a reading of 'Eltkuzian (Ildigizian) ... Yeltkuz atabek'; a gap-filler should open a page on the Orbelian lordship of Syunik, which the page does not describe. wikidata id null.
